Osmium Sound (Dev)

Development builds of Osmium Sound Companion (tags with a "-svil" suffix), published from the same source as https://osmiumsound.qd.je/fdroid/repo but ahead of it and NOT tested to the same standard. Add this repo only if you want early/unstable builds; leave it out to stay on stable releases only. (https://github.com/adri6412/osmium-sound).

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://osmiumsound.qd.je/fdroid/dev/repo
